document_title: Second Errata to Georgia Power's 2025 IRP - replacement Section G.3 (Interconnections) for the IRP Main Document
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=221826 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP 'dkt_56002_56003_2025_irp_errata_3-14-2025_pd.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/221826/102953. Unzipped it and took only 'Main Document/2025 IRP Main Document Section G.3.docx'. Converted that DOCX by reading word/document.xml out of the DOCX zip with Python zipfile + ElementTree, emitting one line per <w:p> paragraph, mapping <w:tab> to a tab and <w:br>/<w:cr> to a newline. No other cleanup - tabs, blank paragraphs and table cell order are exactly as stored in the file. Trade-secret members of the same archive were left alone. PAIRS WITH: ga-56002-irp-2025-main-document-pd.txt. This replacement section reads 'interconnected with 14 non-associated utilities through 68 different transmission facilities'; the original Section G.3 in the Main Document reads 12 and 61.
